title: Detailed lollipop
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Stick -->
  <rect x='46' y='52' width='8' height='42' rx='4' fill='#F5E6C8'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='52' width='2.5' height='42' rx='1.25' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
  <!-- Stick wrap bottom -->
  <rect x='45' y='60' width='10' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#E8D5A8'/>

  <!-- Lollipop candy base circle -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='26' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <!-- Candy lighter rim -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='24' fill='#FF8FB8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='#FF6B9D'/>

  <!-- Spiral stripes -->
  <!-- Stripe 1 - white -->
  <path d='M50 38 C50 34 54 30 58 32 C62 34 62 40 58 44 C54 48 46 48 42 44 C38 40 38 32 44 28 C50 24 60 26 64 34 C68 42 64 52 56 56 C48 60 36 56 34 46 C32 36 40 26 50 24' fill='none' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Stripe 2 - lighter pink highlight -->
  <path d='M50 42 C50 38 52 35 55 36 C58 37 58 41 55 43 C52 45 47 44 45 41 C43 38 45 33 49 30 C53 27 59 29 61 34' fill='none' stroke='#FFD1E3' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Stripe 3 - darker pink accent -->
  <path d='M50 34 C50 31 52 29 55 30 C58 31 58 35 55 37 C52 39 47 38 45 35 C43 32 45 28 49 26' fill='none' stroke='#E84A7F' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Shine highlight on candy -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='29' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.35' transform='rotate(-30 41 29)'/>
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='27' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.5' transform='rotate(-30 39 27)'/>

  <!-- Candy edge shading -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='26' fill='none' stroke='#D94A75' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
